subject: Not what the X-Men are for
body: Kitty walks through walls but she cant hit anything while she's phased, so dont phase into a fight expecting to win it. Keep an eye on the meter, when it runs out you go solid wherever you are and the game shoves you out of the wall. And no, I couldnt talk her into phasing me into a bank vault. Apparently thats "a felony" and "not what the X-Men are for."
